name: 000: Ep1: Thế giới bên trong chiếc hộp trắng
source:
'000: Ep1: The World within the White Box' is the first part of the short stories series.

This story is a collection of different moments in memory, under the main characters point of view. No matter what happen, they will keep on living.

Hoping tomorrow will be a more beautiful day and you don't wanna miss it.

[From [url=https://ikaanaide.itch.io/000-ep1-the-world-within-the-white-box]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《000：第一集：白盒子里的世界》是短篇小说系列的第一部。

这个故事是在主角的视角下，记忆中不同时刻的集合。不管发生什么，他们都会继续生活。

希望明天会是更加美好的一天，你不想错过。

[来自[url=https://ikaanaide.itch.io/000-ep1-the-world-within-the-white-box]Itch.io[/url]]
